title: Strict increase of biased minus probability
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be monotone in the coordinatewise order and nonconstant. For $p\in[0,1]$, form the polynomial $Q_f(p)=\frac{1-\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}(1-2p)^{|S|}\widehat f(S)}{2}$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the uniform Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$. Then $Q_f$ is strictly increasing on $[0,1]$.
